name: @mentio-dev/sdk-python
description: Tooling package for the mentio Python SDK: regenerates the client and its facade from the OpenAPI document, runs the tests, builds the wheel. The Python package itself is published to PyPI as `mentio`.

scripts.generate: uvx --python 3.12 openapi-python-client@0.29.1 generate --path ../sdk/openapi.json --output-path mentio --config openapi-python-client.yml --custom-template-path templates --meta none --overwrite && tsx scripts/generate-facade.ts
